title: Purdys Chocolate Fundraiser 🍫
description:
Chocolate for you. A new playground for the kids. Everybody wins!

Stock up on Purdys treats for gifting, sharing or keeping for yourself. **100% of the fundraiser’s profits go toward Mineola’s new outdoor playscape.**

**Order by:** Monday, November 23  
**Pickup:** Week of December 14, with before- and after-school pickup times to be announced.

**How to order:**

- Choose **“Ship to coordinator”** for free delivery to the school.
- Ordering for friends or family? Ask them to use their own name and email, and add your full name in brackets in the **First Name** field if you’ll collect their order.
